summary: Teach collectives as coordinated transformations of distributed buffers before comparing algorithms.
outcomes: Hand-execute broadcast, gather, reduce-scatter and all-reduce.
Compare ring and tree communication costs under stated assumptions.
sequence: Label two-rank input and desired output buffers.
Build reduce-scatter plus all-gather into all-reduce.
Count bytes and steps for ring/tree designs.
Connect collective semantics to training and domain decomposition.

visual.question: Which rank owns each partial result after this step?
visual.interaction: Step ring phases and vary rank count.

practice.task: Trace a four-rank all-reduce and compare a tree alternative.
practice.success: Every final value matches the centralized reference and the cost model states its limits.
